description: I am looking for teammates who are willing to stive forward through challenges and solve this problem with innovations. I would prefer for you to have skills in coding and software but if you are simply willing to learn how to do so along the way, that is also great.
summary: I developed this project by writing down what it should contain and how it is supposed to look, then, typing the idea down in Base44 which is an AI app builder. After that, I rewrote the codes in Base 44 into stack blitz and made edits in the code. This project addresses the challenge by acting as a medical instruction manual, online therapist, and a journal. There are tabs in the app that can be used to call loved ones, these tabs were made to deal with isolation. There are also tabs that check on the relationship between the team of astronauts, this is to help with keeping the individuals in the team in good terms with each other. there are more tabs made with the aim of helping with different issues. It was inspired by the SCDF apps in Singapore, and my experience as a Red Cross cadet. the challenges addressed are important as they are major issues for the human body and mind that can leave permanent health issues.
details:
